newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were mostly stable in late trading, with declines in Malaysia and the on-going election campaign keeping the market quiet.
Traders said palm olein was quoted at 1,460-65 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening, but trades were also heard at 1,450-55 rupiah.

"The market is very quiet because of the campaign, and due to declines in Malaysia which affected sentiment," one trader said. "There was also talk of supply being tight, but it is not having an impact on prices yet."
The traders also said the export tax on crude palm oil and its products announced on Monday by the finance ministry were in line with industry expectations.

The tax on crude palm oil was raised to $47.32 a tonne in May from $41.08 in April. The tax on RBD palm olein was raised to $68.60 from $54.60, while that on RBD palm oil was increased to $53.04 from $43.68.

Data from Belawan Port showed that the MT Istana-V left the North Sumatran port on Sunday for Cirebon in west Java with 2,000 tonnes of palm olein.The MT Istana-I arrived at Belawan with 1,700 tonnes of crude palm oil from Dumai on Saturday.
